questions.title: Mutex Counter Result
questions.description: What does the following code print?
questions.codesnippet:
m = Mutex.new
c = 0
ts = 3.times.map do
  Thread.new do
    m.synchronize { c += 1 }
  end
end
ts.each(&:join)
puts c

questions.title: Queue Producer Consumer Sum
questions.description: What does the following code print?
questions.codesnippet:
q = Queue.new
prod = Thread.new { [1, 2, 3].each { |x| q.push(x) }; q.push(nil) }
cons = Thread.new do
  s = 0
  while (v = q.pop); s += v; end
  s
end
prod.join
puts cons.value

questions.title: Fiber Fibonacci Stream
questions.description: What does the following code print?
questions.codesnippet:
fib = Fiber.new do
  a, b = 1, 1
  loop do
    Fiber.yield a
    a, b = b, a + b
  end
end
puts (1..5).map { fib.resume }.join(",")
